title: Layer count of the parity circuit tail
statement: For natural numbers $r$ and $q$ and a gate $g$ that is either AND or OR, the parity circuit tail constructed with parameters $r$, $q$, and $g$ has layer count $q+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is an AND or OR gate
